tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /me dbang 'byung 'dul rjes gnang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ rgyal kun mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje yis/ /bdud dang mu stegs ming gi mthar byas nas/ /grub gnyis dge legs dpal du 'bar ba po/ /bla ma phyag na rdo rjes dge legs stsol/ /dpal chen 'byung po 'dul byed kyi/ /rje gnang me dbang bya 'dod pas/ /dben pa'i gnas su stegs kyi khar/ /maṇ+ḍal tshom bu mañdzi'i steng / /zlum gtor rgyan ldan gtor gur bcas/ /de mdun gtor ma mchod bcas bshams/ /rang mdun rdor dril me tog dang / /nang mchod yungs dkar gu gul sogs/ /nyer mkho ma lus bshams bya'o/ /mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs nas mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar dril gsil/ dharma ra ṇi lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'dra/ rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying khar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'byung po 'dul byed bla ma mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra pa ṇā+e sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyun bshags lan gsum tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shū n+yā tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rtsa phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/

g.yas gnyis pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pas dgra bgegs la bsnun pa/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thur du brkyang ba'i rtser mo 'bar ba las gnod byed bsregs par byed pa zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ dbu skra smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po mig gsum pa lag pa bzhi pa g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ skra ser po'i thor tshugs can kha bub tu mnan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rang 'dra'i khro chung tshon gang pas gtams pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+ri bhā wa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi nus pa gter/ /log 'dren bdud bzhi'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs rang la thim/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭaḥ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ tshom bu dang gtor chen suṃ bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang zhes pa nas/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs kyi bar gong bzhin la rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs sngon 'gros phul/ bstod pas bstod/ gtor chung bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ badz+ra pā ṇi'i mthar/ a kā ro btags pas phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin/ slar yang gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ ma hā bhu ta sa pa ri wa ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ dril bu gsil zhing / 'jig rten skyong ba'i 'byung po rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi 'gre'o/ /mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed dang lo dus ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes su maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags bya/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la dpal phyag na rdo rje'i rjes su gnang ba dang dbang bskur ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas bgegs mthar byed dpag tu med pa spros nas bgegs bskrad par bsams la/

rol mo'i sgra dang yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug sngags brjod pas bgegs bsal/ yang 'od zer spro bsdus slob ma'i lus sbyangs nas srung 'khor 'byung 'dul sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bskyed/ sangs rgyas byang sems phyag rdor gyi rnam pas spyan drangs nas bstim/ dril gsil dang sngags/ bdug pa sogs bya/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag pas brtan par byas/ de'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba sogs spyi 'gre/ gsung bzlas lung dam bca'/ thugs sangs rgyas byang sems phyag rdor gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa dang / mdun bskyed nas sku tshon gang pa mched nas bstim la mnyam par bzhag pa sogs spyi 'gre/ gtor ma lhar gsal bas dbang bskur la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing / /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /'od du zhu nas thim pa sogs 'dra/ mtha' brten me dbang rnam bzhi las/ dang po gnam lcags me 'bar gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim pas rkyen byas/ des kyang sems dpa' dang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gnyis ka mer 'bar lus kyi nang thams cad gang nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad gzhob thul gyi bsregs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ sngags rol bdug pa bya/ yang mgal me lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khog nang gi me spyi bo dang rkang mthil nas 'thon te lus kyi phyir mgal me lta bu 'khor bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ yang me 'bar glang chen gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ lus kyi phyir 'bar ba'i me des gnas khang lung pa yul phyogs gling bzhi gling phran stong gsum gyi khams thams cad khyab pas log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad pa sogs/

yang 'phro 'du khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rang gi sngon las stobs che ba rnams nad gdon gyi rnam par shar ba mes bsreg ma nus pa thams cad slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas rang 'dra'i khro bos dpag tu med pa spros te mtshon chas gtub cing sha rus zhal du gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ gzhan 'dra/ slob ma dang slob dpon gyi rjes chog thams cad spyi 'gre bzhin no// //'di yang sa skya pa kun blos sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ me dbang 'byung 'dul rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
